metadata.description: The release tooling's suites about the release itself rather than the host: arming the release pull request, moving a copy's version, dispatching a publish, publishing to stand-in registries, the tracking issue, the version the published clients state, the registry proof of the three clients against stand-in registries, and — selected by path from release-artifacts' own directory, where the skill's testing reference and the end-to-end registry journey name it — test_registries.py, the route registry proofs, which release-artifacts' own test target leaves out. They drive the tool's command line over stand-ins on loopback and real copies of the tree; the registry proof's protocol leg does not depend on the host, and every platform still builds, installs and proves the same three clients from the tree in release-artifacts' test_clients.py, while install-path.yml runs the real registry proofs per platform. Nested in release-artifacts, whose fixtures and helpers they import, so they run once while that project's artifact and route proofs run on every platform.

typecheck.command: uv run -q ty check tools/release-artifacts/tests/independent && uv run -q ty check --python-platform win32 tools/release-artifacts/tests/independent

test.command: uv run -q coverage run -m pytest tools/release-artifacts/tests/independent tools/release-artifacts/tests/test_registries.py
